patterns.reminder: Certificate verification disabled outside a test. In shipped code this belongs only in @packages/https-proxy, where intercepting the AUT's TLS is the point. Anywhere else it silently downgrades a real user's connection.

Electron webPreferences change. A renderer that loads any remote or AUT-influenced content must keep contextIsolation on and nodeIntegration off; expose capabilities through an explicit preload bridge instead. Note packages/server/lib/gui/windows.ts already derives webSecurity from the user's chromeWebSecurity config.
Looks like a hardcoded credential. Read it from the environment or the secret manager. This repo is public, and git history is not erasable.

A record key or auth token is reaching a log, error, or snapshot. Pass it through hideKeys() from @packages/config first, the way packages/server/lib/modes/record.ts does before building CLOUD_RECORD_KEY_NOT_VALID.

Untrusted event text in a workflow. Never interpolate it into a run: block - bind it to an env var and quote the expansion. Workflows here already carry WORKFLOW_DEPLOY_KEY and CYPRESS_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, so an injection is a credential disclosure.

Touching a response security header. Confirm the change reaches only application-under-test responses, never the Cypress UI's own origin or a third-party request the AUT happens to make. See packages/proxy/lib/adapters/remove-security.ts for the existing boundary.

Origin decided by substring match. Compare parsed URL components (protocol, hostname, port) instead - a prefix or includes() check treats evil-example.com.attacker.net as example.com and can leak cookies or intercepted traffic across origins.
